notes.title: Sokpop s Bamboo EP: games from Bernband dev & co.
notes.notes: Sokpop, the Dutch collective whose members were behind such lovelies as Bernband and Lisa (the one with the nice meadow, not Lisa: The Painful RPG), have released a collection of small games. The Bamboo EP [Steam page] contains three games which involve bamboo in some way but are all quite different. They cover the three main genres of video game: swimming in ponds; swordfighting animals; and local multiplayer ballsports. That’s worth three quid to me all right. … [visit site to read more]
